details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:515-548 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: seed_git() puts excluded tracked files into the synthetic Git object database without applying the read-only snapshot’s secret-file filter.
  WHY: An isolated agent can retrieve excluded files such as `.env` through Git and return their contents through the model broker, bypassing the snapshot’s exclusions.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:268-318 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: snapshot_workspace() copies secret-bearing files without applying the read-only snapshot’s exclusion filter.
  WHY: Workspace-mode agents and network-enabled dependency-install containers can read copied secrets and expose them, including through project-controlled install code.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1513; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1514 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the template’s `_is_approvable_read_loop` exception, leaving the two copies divergent.
  WHY: The parity and literal-ID read-loop tests fail because safe read loops are prompted instead of allowed; OpenAI rated this major while the other reviewers rated it blocker.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1902 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The sandbox prepare invocation sets `GITHUB_WORKSPACE` to `RB_OPENCODE_WORKSPACE`, whose scratch workspace lacks `.git`.
  WHY: `review_untrusted_sandbox.sh prepare` rejects the workspace, so the review-blocked fix writer cannot run; z-ai_glm-5_2 rated this major while the other reviewers rated it blocker.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21141-21148; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21588-21616 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked fix path ignores a nonzero isolated-execution status and can treat the absence of transferred changes as a merge decision.
  WHY: A failed fix attempt can lead the poller to remove `ai:review-blocked`, add `ai:ready-to-merge`, and merge the defective pull request.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:183-185 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Docker image’s npm alias requests a version with `-linux-x64` appended to the Codex version.
  WHY: If that version is not published, image construction fails and every isolated Codex run is blocked.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:5661-5676 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup step does not invoke `codex_isolated_exec.sh cleanup` for the persistent sandbox root created during implementation.
  WHY: Sandbox directories, snapshots, virtual environments, and labeled containers accumulate on persistent runners; openai_gpt-6-luna did not report this finding.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8689-8696 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The conflict-marker check scans the cached diff after `git add -u`, which does not stage newly created files.
  WHY: The check misses conflict markers in untracked files; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and minimax_minimax-m3 report that such a file can reach the integration branch, while z-ai_glm-5_2 says it remains uncommitted and rates the issue nit.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6751-6763 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The required-security-asset preflight does not include `scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh`, which `scripts/security_audit.sh` now invokes.
  WHY: If the helper is absent or unstaged, the audit fails with command-not-found instead of following the poller’s `engine_unavailable` path; google_gemini-3_8-flash rated this nit while the other reviewers rated it major.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:759-761 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The decomposer’s timeout can escalate to SIGKILL before the isolated-execution helper’s EXIT trap cleans up the broker and container.
  WHY: A timeout can leave broker processes and Docker containers on the runner.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:113-121 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `docker_env()` runs Docker under `env -i` while preserving only PATH and HOME, stripping Docker daemon connection variables.
  WHY: Self-hosted runners using remote, rootless, or TLS-secured Docker daemons cannot connect; google_gemini-3_8-flash rated this nit while the other reviewers rated it major.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:450-505 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: transfer() applies deletions and writes incrementally without rolling back prior host changes when a later operation fails.
  WHY: The host worktree can be left partially modified, and the review-blocked caller may treat non-empty model output as success despite transfer failure.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:98-102 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: valid_path() rejects valid absolute paths containing characters outside its restrictive regular expression.
  WHY: A workdir, include-file, or Codex-home path containing such characters is rejected before the agent pipeline can run.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:213-250 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The dependency-installation container has network access and a writable mount of the workspace snapshot.
  WHY: A compromised package install script can read snapshot files and exfiltrate them over the network.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml: not cited | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new Codex isolation contract and behavior test modules are not run by any CI test job.
  WHY: Regressions in the isolation invariants can pass CI without detection; minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_2 reported this as a task gap rather than a standard finding.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: “tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py”, “tests/test_codex_isolated_exec.py”, and “tests/test_codex_isolated_workspace.py” cover the isolation contract and behavior and must run in CI.
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, under `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` or another test job
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The three test modules are added but do not appear in any CI job step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- requirement: The documented sandbox cleanup contract requires removing the persistent sandbox root after implementation completes.
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/implement.yml`, the “Cleanup temporary artifacts” step or a cleanup step after implementation
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The cleanup step removes other temporary artifacts but does not call `codex_isolated_exec.sh cleanup --root "${CODEX_ISOLATED_IMPLEMENT_ROOT}"`; the cleanup subcommand exists but no production code path invokes it.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py: seed_git() lines 515-547, specifically line 529 `git rev-list --objects <tree>` | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: seed_git() imports excluded tracked file blobs into the synthetic Git repository without applying the read-only snapshot’s exclusions.
  WHY: An isolated agent can retrieve excluded content with Git and include it in a model response sent through the broker.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py: snapshot_workspace() lines 280-318 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: snapshot_workspace() copies files without excluding secret-bearing paths.
  WHY: Workspace-mode agents and networked dependency-install code can read copied secrets and expose them.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py: evaluate() line 1513 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the template’s read-loop exception, so the two copies diverge.
  WHY: Safe literal-ID read loops are prompted instead of allowed, and the parity and CI tests fail.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml: "Run Codex implementation" step lines 2600-2630 and "Cleanup temporary artifacts" step lines 5661-5676 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The cleanup step does not invoke the sandbox cleanup subcommand for the persistent root created by the implement step.
  WHY: Sandbox directories and labeled Docker containers accumulate on persistent runners.
- tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py (new), tests/test_codex_isolated_exec.py (new), tests/test_codex_isolated_workspace.py (new) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new isolation tests are not wired into any CI test job.
  WHY: The isolation invariants have no automated CI enforcement.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: _integration_judge_commit_and_push() lines 8689-8696 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `git add -u` does not stage new files before the cached-diff conflict-marker check.
  WHY: Conflict markers in a newly created file can evade the check and reach the push.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh: lines 183-184, the `npm install` command building the Docker image | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The npm alias requests the Codex version with `-linux-x64` appended.
  WHY: If the suffixed version is unpublished, Docker image construction fails and isolated Codex runs cannot start.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 6751-6763, the `required_security_asset` preflight loop | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The security-asset preflight omits `scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh`, which the security audit now invokes.
  WHY: The audit can fail with command-not-found instead of following the poller’s `engine_unavailable` path.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml: lines 759-761, the decomposer step wrapping `codex_isolated_exec.sh run --mode read-only` with `timeout --kill-after=30s --` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The timeout can kill the helper before its EXIT trap cleans up the broker and container.
  WHY: Broker processes and Docker containers can remain on the runner after a decomposer timeout.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh: docker_env() line ~113, passing `env -i PATH="${PATH}" HOME="${HOME:-/tmp}"` to Docker | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: docker_env() strips Docker daemon connection variables.
  WHY: Isolated Codex steps fail on self-hosted runners configured with a remote or TLS-secured Docker daemon.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh: valid_path() lines 98-102, regex `^/[A-Za-z0-9._@+/-]+$` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: valid_path() rejects absolute paths containing otherwise valid POSIX path characters.
  WHY: Such a path causes the pipeline to abort before agent work begins.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py: transfer() lines 450-505 | severit
